prompt: On my Today list, move 'Write the retro notes' so it sits immediately after 'Review the PRs'. Leave everything else where it is.
paraphrases: Reposition 'Write the retro notes' on Today to right below 'Review the PRs', without disturbing the other items' order.
On Today, slot 'Write the retro notes' in just after 'Review the PRs'.

assertions.query: SELECT title FROM TMTask WHERE trashed=0 AND title IN ('Reply to customer emails','Review the PRs','Update the changelog','Deploy the release','Write the retro notes') ORDER BY todayIndex

pseudoScript: things reorder "$(things today --json | jq -r '.data.children.today.items[]|select(.title=="Write the retro notes")|.uuid')" --in today --after "$(things today --json | jq -r '.data.children.today.items[]|select(.title=="Review the PRs")|.uuid')"
